application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The applicant has submitted insufficient information for the discharge of Condition 7 (Cycle Parking Facilities) Therefore, the proposal fails to ensure that appropriate opportunities to promote sustainable transport are taken up, in accordance with policy T5 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS6 and DM8 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The applicant has submitted insufficient information for the discharge of Condition 8 (Waste and Recycling Facilities) Therefore, the proposal fails to ensure proper waste management in the interests of the character and appearance of the area and the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy SI 7 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS9 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The applicant has submitted insufficient information to satisfy the requirements of Condition 9 (Landscape Plan) and therefore has failed to ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development in accordance with Policy DM10 (Design Requirements for New Developments including House Extensions) of the LDF Core Strategy Adopted April 2012.

The applicant has submitted insufficient information regarding Condition 14 (Drainage). Therefore, the proposal fails to demonstrate it would prevent the development from increasing the risk of flooding to the site itself or elsewhere, in accordance with policy SI.13 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS1 and DM4 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
description: Details required for Conditions 3 (Facing Materials), 7 (Cycle Parking Facilities), 8 (Waste and Recycling Facilities), 9 (Landscape Plan), 10 (Nature Conservation), 13 (Construction Management Plan), 14 (Drainage) of planning permission 23/03494/FUL (Demolition of an existing bungalow and erection of new 2 storey house)
